basic_info.name: CrackTree260
basic_info.description: CrackTree260 is a pavement crack segmentation subset from the DeepCrack benchmark containing 260 top-down area-array road-surface images (206 at 800x600 and 54 at 960x720) captured under visible-light illumination with pixel-level binary crack masks.

annotation_schema.description: Binary crack masks paired with each CrackTree260 image

quality_assurance.annotation_quality: Pixel-level binary crack masks distributed in the DeepCrack dataset release (introduced in DeepCrack 2019 as an expansion of the CrackTree206 predecessor lineage from Zou et al. 2012).
